Crash · Lithuania

Dumblė · cross-border cigarette drone intercepted in Lithuania

16 October 2026 – 17 October 2026 · Dumblė · cross-border cigarette drone

VSAT-confirmed cross-border cargo drone intercepted and recovered

Friday night; recovered Saturday morning, 16–17 October 2026: Anti-drone equipment interrupted the aircraft; darkness and fog delayed recovery until daylight. The drone was damaged in its fall. 100 NZ Gold cigarette packs with Belarusian tax stamps.

Dumblė village area, Šalčininkai district; recovered about 290 m inside the Belarus border. Cross-border criminal transport from Belarus according to VSAT; operator nationality and state sponsorship unestablished.

VSAT's 19 October report says 'Penktadienio naktį' (Friday night), with recovery after dawn Saturday. The 16–17 October interval is inferred from those weekdays; exact flight time and midnight boundary are unpublished. Replay uses the first date. Reported impact damage supports crash; electronic intervention is not a kinetic shoot-down. One occurrence for electronic intervention, crash and subsequent recovery. Separate from N099 and earlier October seizures; aggregate annual totals add no events.
